Counterfactual test (matched Route2 base/CF pair from the DayTCN counterfactual run): for 6 sites the 2026 satellite tile is replaced by an alternative land-use image, holding time features fixed. A model that uses imagery should shift its prediction; only-time cannot. Δ = mean(Route2-CF − Route2-base) over the test period.

All three models are the latest planning_light line on the 2026 test set (143 sites × 96 slots, identical ground truth). Route2 (satellite + network/traffic JSON + time) beats Route1 (visual + time) and only-time on every global metric. The counterfactual test (tab ⑤) additionally shows Route2 responds to land-use change, which only-time cannot.

Global GEH-median — only-time vs Route1 vs Route2 (lower is better)

GEH-median over all 143 sites by 96 slots on the 2026 test set (this demo). Lower is better.
